description: This file defines various SwiftUI views, actors, and helper structures for managing and displaying session preview items in an OpenClaw application, including caching, limiting concurrent operations, and loading session previews asynchronously.

classes.name: SessionPreviewCache
classes.description: An actor responsible for caching session preview snapshots for quick retrieval.

classes.name: SessionPreviewLimiter
classes.description: An actor that limits the number of concurrent preview fetch operations.

methods.name: cachedSnapshot(for: maxAge:)
methods.description: Retrieves a cached session preview snapshot if it's still valid based on maxAge.

methods.name: store(snapshot: for:)
methods.description: Stores a session preview snapshot in the cache.

methods.name: lastSnapshot(for:)
methods.description: Retrieves the last stored snapshot for a session key, regardless of age.

methods.name: withPermit
methods.description: Performs an async operation with a permit limiting concurrent executions.

methods.name: _testSet
methods.description: Test helper to manually set cache entries during testing.

methods.name: _testReset
methods.description: Resets the cache entries during testing.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a session preview snapshot, using cache if available, otherwise fetches asynchronously.

methods.name: prewarm
methods.description: Preloads session previews for a set of session keys to improve performance.
